defect: the receiving data is synchronized by registers clocked in the source domain
rationale: data_slow crosses into the independent clk_fast domain, but both sampling stages use clk_slow and data_fast is only a combinational view of the source-domain stage.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The synchroniser flops are clocked by the source clk_slow, so data_fast reaches clk_fast logic with no destination-clock synchronisation (and is an unqualified 8-bit bus).

provenance.adaptation: Kept the slow-source and fast-destination interface context and reduced the sampled data path to a small self-contained module.

mutation.description: Clocked both sampling stages with clk_slow, leaving no clk_fast-domain synchronizer for data_fast.
